stem: Xavier would like to add some sentences to help transition from the third paragraph (sentences 14-17) to the fourth paragraph (sentences 18-26). Which of the following could Xavier add after sentence 17?

options.label: F
options.text: A helicopter could be dangerous. Obviously, it would be costly.

options.label: G
options.text: Should they tear it down? Should they use a helicopter?

options.label: H
options.text: People from all around the country had ideas that they wanted to share. Some were good; others not so much.

options.label: J
options.text: Each suggestion had its own problems. And in the meantime Grady remained stuck.
